name: This portfolio
tagline: The site you are on: every repository describes itself in one file, and the site is rebuilt from them.
description:
Each of my repositories carries .portfolio/project.json. Every build reads them all from GitHub, applies one publication policy, checks every link, and prerenders a page per project with Vue and vite-ssg. A private repository appears only by its own consent and in its own words; its name and its source never leave GitHub.

Light and dark themes, a command palette, an interactive map of the LUCY family, and tests in three browser engines.
highlights: Generated from a metadata file in every repository: adding a project is adding a file
Private repositories publish in their own words; their names never reach the site
Every link checked at build time: a dead one is dropped, a private one never published
Prerendered, so every page works before JavaScript runs
Unit and end-to-end tests in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, with axe on every page
